authorization_evidence.summary: The user explicitly directed website contact collection to be enabled without waiting for Jon and delegated the decision to Codex. Codex limits this decision to manually reviewed business phone evidence; automated email extraction is excluded.

scope: Time-limited, manually initiated own-business-website phone collection for genuinely qualified QBCC pilot records and authenticated internal review only
purpose: Assess whether a relevant contractor business has a usable public business phone contact and preserve evidence for internal review; no calls, messages, contact permission or external hand-off
privacy_applicability_and_notice_assessm: No qualified assessment obtained. The user delegates this narrow owner decision; the public notice and conservative collection limits are not represented as an APP compliance determination.

official_guidance_reviewed.title: ACMA - Avoid sending spam
official_guidance_reviewed.relevant_guidance: ACMA identifies prohibitions concerning address-harvesting software and lists created with it, separately from consent requirements for marketing messages.
official_guidance_reviewed.operational_decision: Exclude automated email extraction and email-address indexing from this pilot. This conservative scope decision is not a legal finding that any particular software or phone collection complies with the Spam Act. No message or consent request is sent.

official_guidance_reviewed.title: OAIC - Chapter 5: APP 5 Notification of the collection of personal information
official_guidance_reviewed.relevant_guidance: For an APP entity, reasonable notification or awareness steps depend on the circumstances and generally precede or accompany collection, or follow as soon as practicable. Relevant matters include identity, source, purpose, recipients, privacy information and practicable overseas-country disclosure.
official_guidance_reviewed.operational_decision: Publish the scoped research notice before admission, retain accurate source and request contacts, and explicitly disclose what is unknown. Publication alone is not certified as individual awareness or sufficient APP 5 compliance; applicability and a qualified assessment remain unresolved.

personal_information_acknowledged: Public business phone numbers, mobile numbers, names and website captures may identify sole traders, staff or other individuals. Public availability is not consent. Encrypted page evidence may incidentally contain email addresses and other personal information even though email extraction and indexing are disabled.

source_and_admission.source: Manually supplied, verified own-business HTTPS website root; no search-engine or directory discovery adapter
source_and_admission.phone_format: Valid Australian E.164 numbers classified as actual MOBILE or FIXED_LINE; no extensions, short, ambiguous or non-Australian numbers. Other number classes, including 1300/1800, are not relabelled as landlines or collected under this scope.
source_and_admission.phone_locations: Visible static page text and tel links only, with bounded matching and labelled business identifiers excluded; no script execution or hidden account data
source_and_admission.eligible_record: Active unsuppressed tier A or B QBCC lead, current target geography and an eligible pending-enrichment or needs-review candidate qualified within the preceding eight weeks
source_and_admission.current_licence: Genuine active-licence and identity-match review, attributable evidence, reviewed strictly less than 30 days ago; UNKNOWN is not active
source_and_admission.domain_identity: Exact source identifier on the business site, or reviewer-approved name plus full address or phone supported by two independent evidence references; current approved identity expires within 90 days
source_and_admission.site_terms: Actual per-site terms review with an attributable evidence reference and aware timestamp strictly less than 30 days old, permitting the bounded collection; a checkbox, robots permission or absence of a detected prohibition is not a substitute
source_and_admission.source_permission_not_inferred: This owner decision does not grant a website operator's permission, override its terms, or infer permission merely because a number or page is publicly listed. Each site's actual applicable restrictions must be reviewed before a request.
allowed_evidence: normalised business phone channel and value
encrypted normalised endpoint value and versioned keyed lookup token
own-domain identity and current licence review references
source URL and UTC collection time
encrypted page capture and limited evidence excerpt
content hash, parser/collector version, robots and terms decision references
collection job and internal review state
source_and_admission.contact_permission: Every collected phone remains unverified and requires separate permission, relevance and any DNCR review; collection never authorises a call
source_and_admission.cooldown: No repeat completed or exhausted group-family attempt within 90 days; interruption is not invented exhaustion

crawler_limits.origin_policy: Same registrable domain; public IP validation and connection pinning; no private/metadata addresses, rebinding, login, bot-control bypass, headless browser, 403/429 bypass or external assets
crawler_limits.robots_and_terms: Respect robots and stricter site terms; incomplete evidence does not establish permission
crawler_limits.authority_rechecks: Before queued execution, before and after DNS and each HTTP request, and before the final contact commit; revocation or expiry stops the operation

notice_strategy.contact_basis: Existing published Maintain Media website contact; no new mailbox, identity verification or message delivery is claimed
notice_strategy.actual_source_disclosure: QBCC public register for business records and each business's own website for phone evidence; ABR, Google Sheets and GHL are not represented as active sources or recipients
notice_strategy.individual_notification_strategy: Publish an accessible source/purpose/retention/recipient-limitation notice before website admission; handle source, correction, deletion and objection requests through the existing contact. No individual email, call or form submission is authorised by this decision.

permitted_architecture.identity: Existing Maintain Media Clerk authentication; Clerk middleware is global

permitted_architecture.vendor_support_and_global_processing_cou: Not fully verified; the user delegates acceptance of this limitation for these existing accounts and this narrow additional phone-evidence scope

retention.selected_evidence_enforcement: The scoped retention policy must explicitly disable selected-evidence archival and apply the ordinary 90-day page limit even if a worklist row exists; disabling email alone is insufficient
retention.suppression: Preserve only the minimum matchable restriction tokens and aliases needed to honour objections; do not restore or re-create erased contact values
retention.holds: Only attributable scoped holds with reason, owner and review date; no blanket indefinite hold
retention.authority_expiry_effect: Stop new website collection at the existing pilot expiry. Continue authorised finite deletion until the existing deletion-authority expiry; no automatic renewal or indefinite retention.
retention.enforcement: A new attributable policy version and current retention G1/G3/G7 continuation evidence must cover website phones, captures and queued requests. The original QBCC-only policy remains immutable. Applicable deletion controls require separate implementation and execution evidence.

g3_pilot_disposition.basis: Separately accept the existing verified Sydney encryption, restricted access and bounded storage for this limited private phone-evidence pilot; do not assume the prior public-QBCC-only disposition included contact data
deferred: full disaster-recovery acceptance and installed-provider database restore
g3_pilot_disposition.risk_accepted_under_delegation: Loss of the host or access keys may lose manual reviews and require rechecking public business websites. Do not claim recovery readiness, restore stale restriction state, or resume collection without current restriction authority.

website_collection.evidence_sha256: Bind to the final exact bytes of this owner decision
